description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for HibernatePersonDAO, focusing on retrieving and manipulating Person objects in the OpenMRS system. It tests various methods including getting people by search criteria, attributes, and relationship types, as well as saving persons with specific data.

classes.name: HibernatePersonDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit Jupiter test class to verify the functionality of HibernatePersonDAO methods related to Person data retrieval and persistence within the OpenMRS system.
